patch_list: Pure black and white color options
Shows pure black and pure white as selectable Lawnchair color options.
Pure black and white color parsing
Adds persistent pure_black and pure_white color values to Lawnchair's color option parser.
Removes the handle and its reserved area from the top of Lawnchair's app drawer.
Removes the top spacing reserved for the All Apps drag handle.
Remove All Apps handle touch area
Removes the obsolete All Apps bottom-sheet handle hit target.
